newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 13.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- South Korean president Kim Young-sam has named Lee Hoi-chang as the next New Korea Party chairman.
- The central Bank of Korea has lowered its forecast for this year's economic growth to six percent from its initial estimate of 6.4 percent in a report submitted to the National Assembly yesterday.
- Choi Hyung-woo, a leading New Korea Party member has been hospitalized since suffering a stroke. Doctors said he was recovering quickly but was still in a semi-comatosed state yesterday.
- Sunkyung Group put a freeze on worker wages this year.

- A high-level North Korea defector's departure from Beijing seems imminent as South Korea and China apparently have turned the corner in their negotiations over the fate of Hwang Jang-yop, an official in Seoul said.
